0.long_answer: Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) is a form of talk therapy that is commonly used to treat equinophobia. This therapy helps patients identify and challenge their irrational thoughts about horses, thereby reducing fear and avoidance behaviors. By gradually exposing patients to their fear in a controlled manner, CBT enables them to develop coping strategies and reframe their perceptions, which has been shown to be effective in reducing symptoms associated with equinophobia.
